# agyn_mcp (Resource)

Manages an Agyn MCP.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# An MCP server runs as a sidecar to every workload in its environment.
resource "agyn_mcp" "search" {
  environment_id = agyn_environment.build.id
  name           = "search"
  image          = "ghcr.io/agynio/mcp-search:v1.0.0"
  command        = "mcp-search --port 8080"
  description    = "Example MCP service."

  # Environment volumes to mount into the sidecar, at the paths the main
  # container uses.
  shared_volumes = ["workspace"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `command` (String) Command to execute.
- `image` (String) Container image.
- `name` (String) MCP name.

### Optional

- `agent_id` (String) Agent that runs this server. Conflicts with environment_id.
- `description` (String) Human-readable description.
- `environment_id` (String) Environment that runs this server in every workload, sandboxes included. Conflicts with agent_id.
- `resources` (Attributes) Compute resource requests and limits. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--resources))
- `shared_volumes` (List of String) Names of environment volumes to mount into this sidecar, at the paths the main container uses.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID identifier of the MCP.

<a id="nestedatt--resources"></a>
### Nested Schema for `resources`

Optional:

- `limits_cpu` (String) CPU limits (for example, 1).
- `limits_memory` (String) Memory limits (for example, 2Gi).
- `requests_cpu` (String) CPU requests (for example, 500m).
- `requests_memory` (String) Memory requests (for example, 1Gi).
